title: What I work on
intro: I work across every layer of a business application, from the data model through to production. These areas match what I practise day to day, both in my job and as an independent developer.

backend.title: Back end and APIs
backend.description: REST APIs and business logic in Laravel, Java 21 / Spring Boot or Node.js / Express. SQL data modelling (PostgreSQL, MySQL), hexagonal architecture, authentication through Keycloak (OAuth2, OIDC).

frontend.title: Interfaces
frontend.description: Angular 21 and Vue.js applications, styled with Tailwind and shadcn. Reusable components versioned as a design system, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility and low-footprint design.

delivery.title: Delivery and production
delivery.description: Linux VPS administration, Docker containers, continuous deployment through GitLab CI or GitHub Actions, database migrations and automated testing (Vitest, JUnit, Pest).

maintenance.title: Taking over existing code
maintenance.description: Gradual rework of ageing code bases, fixes in production, new features, and introducing tests to code that never had any.
